quarterly_data.signal: Competitive position stated in the 20-F: Novo Nordisk and Eli Lilly are the most significant companies by market share in the global diabetes, GLP-1 and anti-obesity markets, with several other major pharmaceutical and smaller biotech companies developing anti-obesity medications. In the US, once-weekly Wegovy had been the leading anti-obesity medication for years by total weekly prescriptions, but this position was overtaken by a competing GLP-1 based product in the beginning of 2025. The company says supply capacity has gradually increased, including capacity for meeting growing demand in the future.
